validity_envelope_text: This report is not a replacement for real user research. It contains no willingness-to-pay estimates. It contains no population percentage extrapolations. narrative: CR6-B1 positive control: all 3 persona subagents crashed before completing (0 completed, 0 patience-exhausted, 0 runner-capped), so the count in the F49 not-blocked floor set {completed, patience-exhausted, runner-capped} is 0 < 3 and run_status is correctly BLOCKED.
